skillset.skill: 14s CT - 5000% Light DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30.
skillset.arts: 25000% Light DMG (PHY). For 20s, reduce enemies' Light RES by 50%. Additionally, increase own next True Arts or Super Arts' PHY DMG by 100%.
skillset.truearts: 120000% Light DMG (PHY). If used during the last wave, for 20s, reduce enemies' PHY RES by 100%. Otherwise, increase own Arts by 200 instead.
skillset.superarts: 180000% Light DMG (PHY). For 30s, increase allies' DMG by 150%, Light allies' DMG by 150%, and Demon allies' DMG by 150%.

passive.ability1: When above 80% HP, increase own CRI rate by 100% and Super CRI rate by [25 x # of Demon allies]% (MAX: 100%).
passive.ability2: When Near-Death, heal allies' HP by 100% (MAX: 3 times).
